findings.title: push leaves the database with no active EQL configuration when the insert fails
findings.label: valid
findings.note: push.ts:33-42 runs an unscoped UPDATE and a separate INSERT with no transaction, so an INSERT failure (e.g. the cast_as CHECK) leaves no active config.

findings.title: install --force drops EQL-dependent indexes and constraints on encrypted columns
findings.label: valid
findings.note: --force re-executes the EQL script, which begins with DROP SCHEMA eql_v2 CASCADE, dropping dependent constraints and indexes, while the code calls it 'safe to re-run'.

findings.title: install executes an unpinned, unverified 'latest' EQL SQL bundle as a privileged role
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Unpinned releases/latest SQL is executed without integrity or version check, while the repo vendors EQL 2.1.8.

findings.title: A positional argument after --dry-run silently disables the dry run
findings.label: valid
findings.note: parseArgs (stash-forge.ts:43-53) consumes the next non-flag token as a value, so '--dry-run foo' leaves flags['dry-run'] unset and the command runs for real.
